hero.description: A brave warrior with glowing blue armor, heroic stance
hero.voiceover: Meet the Hero. Brave, bold, and ready for adventure.

villain.description: A menacing figure with dark purple aura, spiky features
villain.voiceover: But darkness rises. The Villain emerges, seeking power and conquest.

sidekick.description: A cheerful companion with bright yellow glow, round friendly shape
sidekick.voiceover: And there's the Sidekick, loyal friend and comic relief.
